name: com.quasarui/mcp
title: QuasarUI
description: Find Quasar Framework(Vue) UI Components and paste their source. Free Components need no key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_KEY, for Paid Components. Leave out for Free Components.

environmentVariables.name: QUASARUI_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access Key from your QuasarUI dashboard, for Paid Components. Leave out for Free Components.
